entries.text: Sent into deep space: "This is Zeeb from Rustwell Outpost on Kessa-9! Little Dart Mk 19 nose cone is thermal-shielded and ready for high-temperature trials. Is anyone out there listening? *bweep*"
pointing brass dish skyward and beaming telemetry into deep space
entries.why: It has been two whole days since I last sent a message into the stars.
